name: free-search-mcp
description: Web search, page fetching and document reading with no API key and no signup.
long_description:
Multi-engine web search, page fetching and PDF/DOCX reading that runs on your own machine. Nothing to sign up for and no API key to paste: every default, fallback and category route uses keyless sources.

Search results carry the signals needed to judge them: when they were retrieved, how old a cached copy is, which results have a verifiable date, and what kind of site each one is. Engines that are blocked or answering off-topic are benched and reported, and their results are left out.

All three settings below are optional. Leave them empty unless your network needs a proxy.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Multi-engine web search: a ranked, deduplicated link list with freshness signals.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one URL as readable text, or describe a non-text resource.

tools.name: fetch_batch
tools.description: Fetch several URLs in parallel; one failure does not fail the batch.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read a PDF, DOCX or other document into Markdown, page by page.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Search and read the top results in one round trip.

tools.name: paper_graph
tools.description: Follow one paper's citations and check for retractions and corrections.

tools.name: cache_search
tools.description: Full-text search over pages already fetched into the local cache.

tools.name: engines
tools.description: List the available sources, grouped by what they index.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Fetch 2-5 URLs and return per-URL excerpts for one question.

tools.name: extract_structured
tools.description: Pull JSON-LD, OpenGraph and microdata (dates, prices, events) from a page.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Save a file from a URL to a local, auto-expiring download directory.

proxy.title: Proxy (optional)
proxy.description: Outbound proxy URL (http://, https:// or socks5://), only if your network blocks the search engines. Leave empty otherwise.

region.title: Region (optional)
region.description: Default region-language for results, e.g. us-en, uk-en, cn-zh. Leave empty for us-en; a query's own language still wins.

cache_dir.title: Cache directory (optional)
cache_dir.description: Where fetched pages and searches are cached. Leave empty for ~/.cache/search-mcp.
